o: The PAW Patrol is on a roll with adventures that take the pups from the prehistoric wilds of Dino Island to the rock-climbing heights of Rescue Mountain. Along the way, they’ll team up with new friends–from a speedy racing pooch to the legendary Abominable Snow Pup–proving that for this team, no job is too big, no pup is too small!

eps.o: Farmer Al's new machine, the Garboni goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the PAW Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip.
The PAW Patrol have to catch a trouble making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.

eps.t: Pups and the Ace of the Skies
eps.o: Ace's plane gets stuck in the mountains while giving pilot lessons to Skye and it's up to the PAW Patrol to rescue the stranded pilots.
Roles are reversed when Priya has to save the PAW Patrol when animal hijinks ensue.
The Pups are on the case when mechanical issues occur at the new water park, Splashy Bottom.

eps.t: Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide
eps.o: The Pups have to save ancient relics when hijinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum.
The pups are on the hunt for a mysterious critter chewing up everything in sight at the farm.

eps.t: Pups and the Bubble Bath Bay!
eps.o: Rocky falls asleep while avoiding a bath at the Pet Parlor and dreams of a sudsy adventure.
Humdinger wants to be mayor of Dino Island and uses a duplicator to make copies of dinosaurs. The PAW Patrol must enlist the help of the island's dinosaurs to stop Mayor Humdinger.

eps.t: Pups Save Dino Digi and Tal
eps.o: Digi & Tal are visiting Dino Island to help Rex with dinosaur safety. When they take safety too far, they accidentally put the island at risk.
When Daring Danny X's epic dino-stunt goes awry, he winds up with a grouchy Spinosaurus on his trail!
Vanessa Pressley is on Dino Island to film her new dino documentary. Her and the cameraman get carried off by a Brachiosaurus.
Humdinger and Helga visit Dino Island, and get trapped in a cave. The pups have to save everyone before hot lava spills!

eps.t: Pups Save a T-Rex in Trouble
